content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends lifestyle interventions for lipid management that focus on dietary modifications and physical activity to reduce cardiovascular risk. These dietary changes include adopting eating patterns such as the Mediterranean diet or the DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet. Specific recommendations include reducing the consumption of saturated fats and trans fats, increasing the intake of dietary fiber and vegetables, and limiting alcohol consumption. Additionally, regular physical activity is strongly encouraged as part of these interventions.
